GTA 6 to start preloading onto consoles Tuesday
 Greta Cross USA TODAY Nov. 9, 2026, 8:00 a.m. ET Hear this story The release of GTA 6 is just around the corner.
 The highly-anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI releases on Thursday, Nov. 19. Set in Leonida − the franchise's take on Florida − the open-world game can be played through protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, inspired by Bonnie and Clyde.
 The release is the first of the GTA series not sold as a physical disc, only a digital download code. Preorders opened in June , and on Nov. 3, developer Rockstar Games announced that the preordered game would begin downloading on PlayStation and XBOX consoles on Tuesday, Nov. 10 . The preload begins more than a week before the game can be accessed and played due to its large file size.
 Though the game is not being sold as a physical disc, Rockstar also announced on Nov. 3 that a free, printable GTA 6 cover art poster and Leonida map are available on the GTA 6 website . A double-sided version of the poster will also be available for 99 cents or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store after game launch, according to a news release.
 Here's what to know about the GTA 6 preload.

 According to a Rockstar news release, here's when GTA 6 will begin preloading on consoles:
 PlayStation 5: Midnight local time on Tuesday, Nov. 10
 XBOX Series X|S: Midnight GMT on Tuesday, Nov. 10
 How big is the GTA 6 file size?
 The GTA 6 preload requires up to 212 gigabytes, depending on the console, according to a news release.

 Yes, GTA 6 is still available for preorder on the Rockstar Games website , up until release day on Nov. 19.
 How much does the GTA 6 preorder cost?
 Here's how much GTA 6 cost per edition :
 Standard edition: $79.99 (available at PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S digital codes and physical download code in a box)
 Ultimate edition: $99.99 (available at PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S digital codes)
